sec-bot: Heads-up: Critical dependency report found a misconfigured AWS IAM role allowing 'sts:AssumeRole' from an unapproved account. Detected in analytics-batch role. See https://redwood.internal/sec/1938001111

oliver: Wait, is this production? How bad is the exposure?

sec-bot: Affected role is in prod account but bound to an external CI account (external-ci-123). No evidence of exfil, but we consider this high risk. Immediate containment recommended.

sam: I'm on it. Steps: 1) remove the external principal from trust policy; 2) rotate any long-lived keys attached; 3) run access audit. I'll prepare a PR to update trust policy.

ops-oncall: I can schedule a brief maintenance window. Prefer 01:00-02:00 UTC tonight. Will standby.

security-leads: Agreed containment plan. Also create alert to watch for AssumeRole from that principal in CloudTrail for next 7 days. We'll require a postmortem if any anomalous activity appears.

oliver: PR opened: infra#789. Removed external principal and pinned a condition to require MFA and source VPC. Deploying to prod in 15m.

sec-bot: Noted. CloudTrail shows no AssumeRole events from external-ci-123 in the last 90 days. Still enable detective rule and create SEC-2026-049.

sam: Rotation note: rotated all access keys for service-account used by analytics-batch and revoked any unused keys. Updated secret manager entries and restarted batch workers.

ops-oncall: Prod deploy succeeded. Verified analytics-batch jobs ran normal post-restart. Monitoring shows no elevated error rates.

security-leads: Good. Follow-ups: 1) audit all cross-account trust policies; 2) enforce a policy that external principals must be approved by security and have limited session duration; 3) add linter to infra PR checks to flag wildcard principals.

oliver: I'll schedule an infra sweep and add issues. Thanks team.

sec-bot: Closing automated alert. Reminder: owners must attach audit logs to SEC-2026-049 within 72h. If issues, escalate to #incidents. :shield:
